name: planka-mcp
description: Find, read and manage cards on your Planka v2 kanban boards: move them, comment, edit, and tick off checklists.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List the boards you can see, grouped by project

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Show a board as a kanban: lists, labels, members and cards

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find cards by text, board, list, label or assignee

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Get a card with its description, tasks, attachments and latest comments

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Page through the comments of a card

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Create a card on a board, with labels, assignees and a due date

tools.name: move_card
tools.description: Move a card to another list or board, or to the archive

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Edit a card's title, description, due date, labels, assignees or stopwatch

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description: Add tasks, or links to other cards, to a card's checklist

tools.name: update_tasks
tools.description: Tick, untick or rename checklist tasks

planka_url.title: Planka URL
planka_url.description: Base URL of your Planka instance (e.g. https://planka.example.com). Planka v2.0 or later.

planka_api_key.title: API Key
planka_api_key.description: Your personal Planka API key, created for your user by a Planka admin (only admins can create keys). Leave empty to log in with username and password instead.

planka_username.title: Username or email
planka_username.description: For users without an API key: your Planka username or email. Used together with the password; when set, it is used instead of the API key.

planka_password.title: Password
planka_password.description: Your Planka password, used with the username above. Not for accounts that use single sign-on or two-factor authentication: those need an API key.
